tools.name: list_indexes
tools.description: Indexfy index funds on Base with price, TVL and 24h / 7d performance. Each index is an ERC-20 fully backed by its basket of tokens.

tools.name: get_index
tools.description: One index's stats, mandate and current holdings (each basket token's amount, USD value and weight).

tools.name: get_wallet_portfolio
tools.description: A wallet's Indexfy index holdings with value and profit/loss, plus its Indexfy points.

tools.name: build_create_index
tools.description: Launch a new index fund: the wallet seeds it with the exact amount of each basket token (it must hold them) and receives `initialShares` shares. The seed amounts set the weights. Returns the approvals and the factory deployment call, plus the new index's predicted address.

tools.name: register_index
tools.description: Lists a newly created index on indexfy.xyz right away. Call with the deployFolio transaction hash once it's mined.

tools.name: build_buy_index
tools.description: Buy an index with USDC alone: one transaction buys every basket token on KyberSwap and mints the shares, reverting below the quoted minimum. Unspent USDC is refunded.

tools.name: build_sell_index
tools.description: Sell index shares for USDC: one transaction redeems the shares for the basket and sells each token on KyberSwap, reverting below the quoted minimum.

tools.name: list_prediction_markets
tools.description: Prediction markets on Indexfy with live YES/NO prices (= implied probability), money in the market, phase and deadlines.

tools.name: get_prediction_market
tools.description: One market's live state: prices, phase and what can be done next, deadlines, proposal/dispute. With `wallet`, also its shares, redeemable USDC and solver stake.

tools.name: quote_prediction_trade
tools.description: Exact quote from the market maker: shares for a USDC buy, or USDC for a share sell, fees included.

tools.name: build_prediction_trade
tools.description: Buy YES/NO shares with USDC, or sell shares back for USDC before the market closes. Includes the USDC approval when needed and a minimum-output guard.

tools.name: build_create_prediction_market
tools.description: Open a YES/NO market. The wallet seeds it with USDC liquidity (minimum 100) and names a solver — a different address that alone resolves it and stakes 1% as a bond. Trading runs until closeTime; the solver proposes after resolveAfter.

tools.name: register_prediction_market
tools.description: Lists a newly created market on indexfy.xyz under its sector. Call with the createMarket transaction hash once mined, within 1 hour.

tools.name: build_prediction_resolution
tools.description: After trading: propose (the solver; deposits any missing stake first), dispute (anyone but the solver, posting the same bond, during the 24h window), finalize (anyone, once the window passes), redeem (holders, after settlement) or withdraw_liquidity (the creator, after settlement).

tools.name: build_prediction_account
tools.description: Deposit or withdraw solver stake (backs the 1% bonds of your proposals), or withdraw your balance (dispute winnings and returned bonds).
